fitAnalysis.assessment:
Your 40% match is a WEAK FIT for this Senior Customer Enablement Manager role.

**Strengths:**
- Raised Year 11 grade 5+ share from 71% to 86%
- Trained 12 colleagues to use Notion
- Curriculum design, workshop facilitation and one-to-one coaching experience

**Gaps:**
- No 4+ years in customer-facing SaaS roles
- No customer enablement strategy or product adoption experience
- No UX/UI, Design Ops or frontend background

**Recommendation:** Build SaaS customer success or enablement experience first (for example a junior enablement or training role), then reapply, using your teaching outcomes and Google Data Analytics Certificate as proof of training delivery.

Daniel Okafor

daniel.okafor@example.org

October 12, 2026

Hiring Manager
Figma

Dear Hiring Manager,

Helping teams get real value from a tool they already own is mostly a teaching problem, and I've spent eight years solving it. At Ashgrove Academy I raised the share of Year 11 students reaching grade 5 or above from 71% to 86% over three years, by tracking progress in spreadsheets and changing what I taught based on what the data showed. That is the same loop your enablement plans need: understand the goal, read the data, adjust the approach.

Your ad asks for bespoke enablement plans and live training sessions customized to customer maturity. As Head of Year 9, I wrote the department's practical curriculum and trained 12 colleagues to use it, so I know how to design and deliver workshops for adults at different levels of confidence. I also keep weekly parent calls going for a year group of 210 students, which means building trusted relationships with people who start out with very different expectations. I'm new to SaaS and to Figma, and I won't pretend otherwise. I do bring curriculum design, workshop facilitation, one-to-one coaching and a habit of presenting results to senior leadership each term, and I learn fast: I'm working through the Google Data Analytics Certificate and completed Python for Everybody in 2024.

Your "Grow as you go" value describes how I'd approach this role. I'd welcome a conversation about how my teaching background could support your largest customers from the London hub, and I'm available to talk at your convenience.

Kind regards,
Daniel Okafor
